extDesc.message: Turn Dark Reader off/on for the current page with a three-finger tap (Firefox for Android and touch-screen desktops).

rememberLabel.message: Remember sites I turn off (stay off next time)

rememberHint.message: When unchecked: off only while this site is open in this tab (stays off across reloads and in-site navigation).

notes.message: Works only with Dark Reader's Dynamic mode (Filter/Static modes ignore the lock). Add-ons can't run on about: pages, addons.mozilla.org, etc.

toastNotDynamic.message: Dark Reader isn't in Dynamic mode; can't toggle
